$comment: Standalone POI category catalog. No OSM tags are hard-coded in app code — search/pois.ts compiles this into an Overpass query at runtime. Each `match` entry is a set of OSM key=value pairs ANDed together; entries in the array are ORed. `modes` limits which travel modes surface the category. `weight` nudges ranking (1 = neutral). `cap` limits how many of a category survive per search (named ones kept first) so plentiful categories like parking can't crowd out viewpoints.
